candidates.base_prompt:
A warm storybook cartoon illustration for Keywright, a cosy fantasy shop game, based on the approved C2 reference's rounded shapes, warm colours, readable faces and crafted objects, but WITHOUT ANY OUTLINES. Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

The Bottled Star, one of the nine Heartsongs (a beloved object the realm's archmages sang a spell into): a single object, handmade, old and loved, warmer and more personal than any treasure, with one deep-red accent; seen three-quarters from slightly above, upright, centred, filling about ninety percent of the picture, its lowest point on the bottom edge. Background: flat pure magenta #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture.

Subject: A round glass bottle with a cork, holding a tiny star: a bright white-gold point with four short pixel rays, a red string tied around the neck with a little blank card.

It must show: a clear glass bottle; a tiny bright star inside, drawn in pixels; a red string around the neck. Keep these features readable after reduction.

Lean on these palette colours (dark to light; the swatch has them all): steel 3-4 (#93a2b6 #ccd9e8); night 10 (#ffffff); gold 5-6 (#f2c14e #fbeda4); azure 5-6 (#68c7fd #a7f8ff); crimson 4-5 (#c7414e #ff4058).

Avoid: musical notes floating; a background other than flat magenta; a drop shadow; a glow or aura; text or letters; more than one object unless described; outlines, contour strokes or ink linework; pixel-art style or visible pixels; all-over texture, grain, hatching or noise; airbrushed gradients; details too thin to survive reduction; highlights scattered over surfaces; unmotivated decorative clutter.

Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

The Imp's Ember, one of the nine Heartsongs (a beloved object the realm's archmages sang a spell into): a single object, handmade, old and loved, warmer and more personal than any treasure, with one deep-red accent; seen three-quarters from slightly above, upright, centred, filling about ninety percent of the picture, its lowest point on the bottom edge. Background: flat pure magenta #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture.

Subject: An imp's own heart: a glowing red-orange coal shaped like a heart, tiny flames licking at its top, cradled in a small black iron dish.

It must show: a heart-shaped coal; red-orange glow in its own colours; tiny flames on top; a small iron dish. Keep these features readable after reduction.

Lean on these palette colours (dark to light; the swatch has them all): flame (#853c2f #ce5e00 #ffb52e #ffe47d); night 2-4 (#1a1420 #2b2236 #3b3150); crimson 4-5 (#c7414e #ff4058).

Avoid: musical notes floating; a background other than flat magenta; a drop shadow; a glow or aura; text or letters; more than one object unless described; outlines, contour strokes or ink linework; pixel-art style or visible pixels; all-over texture, grain, hatching or noise; airbrushed gradients; details too thin to survive reduction; highlights scattered over surfaces; unmotivated decorative clutter.

Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

Moonstone: a single treasure for a game, seen three-quarters from slightly above as if resting on a counter, upright and centred, filling about ninety percent of the picture, its lowest point on the bottom edge. One bold silhouette, each material in two or three main tones, with three or four readable features. Background: flat pure magenta #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture.

Subject: A smooth round cabochon of milky, faintly blue-white moonstone with a soft shimmer, loose.

It must show: a smooth round dome; milky blue-white; a soft shimmer line. Keep these features readable after reduction.

Lean on these palette colours (dark to light; the swatch has them all): steel 3-4 (#93a2b6 #ccd9e8); azure 5-6 (#68c7fd #a7f8ff); night 8-10 (#c9c4d4 #ece6f5 #ffffff).

Avoid: a background other than flat magenta; a drop shadow; a glow or aura; text or letters; more than one object unless described; outlines, contour strokes or ink linework; pixel-art style or visible pixels; all-over texture, grain, hatching or noise; airbrushed gradients; details too thin to survive reduction; highlights scattered over surfaces; unmotivated decorative clutter.
candidates.appended_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated small game inventory object, continuing approved C2 / 4x / NO OUTLINES. Reference 1 is the approved category anchor for rounded solid shapes, broad cel-shaded material colour and readable useful detail ONLY. Draw the NEW specified object: do not copy the reference's coin shape, square hole, anvil, music box, gold colour or red ribbon unless this object's description calls for it. Reference 2 is the master palette; use the specified material colours. One highest-quality PNG, requested size 1024x1024. The entire object must fit with a modest pure magenta margin on every side, no cut-off tips or attachments. It will reduce to just 32x32 native pixels and display at 2x. Preserve the three or four stated signature features as bold filled shapes; broad continuous main surfaces, only two or three tones per material. No enclosing outer or internal ink contour strokes, no uniform dark silhouette border. Natural material rims and cast shadows within the object are allowed, but must not trace every edge. No dithering, grain, brushed texture, dense facets, tiny scratches or scattered shiny specks. Magenta background is perfectly flat #ff00ff, including holes and all empty gaps. No ground plane, shadow puddle, halo, text, lettering, symbols beyond those specifically requested, frame, label or extra objects. Glass is represented by opaque coloured shapes, not translucent alpha or magenta inside the vessel.
Small-size production constraint: use smooth flat cartoon colour blocks, with two or three SOLID colours per material and at most eight colours overall. No gradients, no painterly or polygonal patchwork. Metal and cloth have large plain surfaces; only signature motifs have detail. Any stamped decoration is a single broad filled shape. No decorative perimeter line or repeated bright rim around objects. Large continuous surfaces must dominate, including on blades, liquid bottles, fabric and gems; use three large facets for gems, never many tiny facets.
